source.title: Duskwood Mission II: Defeat Ogres
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Defeat ogres there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat 3 Deranged Ogres and 3 Demented Fire Weavers in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound and return to Field Captain Palandar.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
